messages:
Mira: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — we captured a short list of action items to reduce rollout blast radius and add metric gates/auto-rollback. Need owners + short timelines so SRE can slot work this week. Items (high level):
1) Auto-rollback based on error-rate + crash metrics
2) Per-service feature-flag simultaneous percentage cap (prevent wide blast)
3) Metric-based canary gates (latency, error, aquality checks)
4) Rollouts dashboard + alerting for tail latency / unseen regressions
5) Runbook/playbook updates and QA checklist for canaries
6) Quarterly rollouts retro + incident pattern tracking
Who can take ownership of 1-3 (or a subset) with a target ship/PR timeline? @Benji @Joel @Lina @Samir please chime in.

Joel: I can own #1 (auto-rollback).
Plan: add a pre-cancel policy in the orchestrator that watches aggregated error-rate + 5xx spike across canary nodes. If threshold breached for X windows, trigger rollback + emit incident event.
I have a prototype in orch that hooks into the traffic router — will open PR w/ tests. Target: PR by Wed EOD, deploy to staging Thu.
Link (proto): https://github.com/redwood-inference/orch/pull/4321

Benji: I'll take #2 (flag percentage cap).
Idea: middleware in flagging service that enforces `max_percent_per_service` and rejects flag updates above limit unless owner override. Default cap 5% rollout.
Impl notes: small DB migration for storing per-service caps + a simple UI toggle in Console.
Target: backend PR by Thu, console patch Friday. :thumbsup:

Lina: I'll own #3 (metric-based canary gates) and help with #4 dashboard alerts.
Approach: create a gating rule schema and wire into the canary controller. Proposed rule sample: 
```
{"gate": "latency_p95", "window_s": 120, "baseline_mul": 1.2, "action": "fail"}
```
I'll spike a PoC that evaluates p95/p50, error rate, and a light quality check hook that can call an external eval service. Target: PoC + dashboard tile by next Tue.

Samir: I'll handle #5 (runbook) and coordinate the quarterly retro (#6).
I'll update the canary runbook with play-by-play, add the new gating checklist, and schedule a recurring post-rollout review (monthly, first Mon after deploy).
Target: runbook draft by Fri, retro scheduled for next month.

deploy-bot: auto-rollback triggered on service-ml at 03:12 UTC — error-rate 4.8% > threshold, rollback executed. (context from incident)

Benji: question — should the cap be opt-in per service or enforced org-wide?

Joel: recommend default enforced but allow scoped overrides via a feature-flagged admin path. Less chance for human error during high-risk deploys.

Lina: agree on default enforcement. For experiments we can add an audit flow that requires two approvers to raise cap.

Mira: Summary: owners set as Joel(#1), Benji(#2), Lina(#3/4), Samir(#5/6). Actionable deadlines above. I'll create the incident tracker ticket and link PRs there. Please drop PR/issue links in that tracker and tag me.
Tracker: https://go/redwood/issue/INC-2198

Joel: Will add RFC section about rollback hysteresis and a small config schema.

Benji: I'll prototype the DB part in a branch and share schema tonight.

Lina: I'll post the gating PoC notes + sample queries to this thread when ready.

Samir: Scheduling follow-up sync for Mon 11:00am — invite sent.

Mira: Thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me or drop a short note in #eng-oncall so SRE can unblock deploys. :rocket:
